proposals.evidence: Turner lists Oriya ākhi/āẽkha, Bengali ã̄kh(i), Hindi ã̄kh and Gujarati ã̄kh under akṣi. These simple survey eye forms retain the diagnostic velar outcome, with nasalization, final agreement and source aspiration notation varying. The assignment is to the comparative eye family; unusual prefixed or further extended forms are excluded rather than normalized.
